meta.title: dsh-mm-resilience
meta.description: Every image is parsed once when it first enters the session and archived; later requests never re-send image bytes — root-cause prevention of multimodal session wedges. Pixel budget and per-message describe cap take over the official defaults (editable, restorable); multi-image parse concurrency is configurable; originals re-viewable on demand (mm_view_image).
